LE CAS DES PRIMO-ARRIVANTS À BRUXELLES
Question n° 8 de M. Mathias VANDEN BORRE du 2 janvier 2021. ...

content.text:
Based on current official Brussels-Capital Region sources, here is the answer to your situation:

## 1) Is it mandatory, and exemptions?

Yes. According to the official Brussels administrative portal,

citations.cited_text:
## Pour qui ?
Une personne est **obligée de suivre le parcours** si elle :

- est inscrite pour la première fois au registre des étrangers d'une commu...
citations.title: Parcours d'accueil obligatoire à Bruxelles

content.text: a person is obliged to follow the integration programme if she is registered for the first time in the foreigners' register of a Brussels municipality with a residence permit for more than 3 months, is between 18 and 65 years of age, and has been legally residing in Belgium for less than 3 years

. Since you are 40, non-EU, registering for the first time with a permit valid more than 3 months, and have lived legally in Belgium for under 3 years, **you fall squarely within the mandatory category**.

The underlying legal basis is the **Ordonnance (Order) of 20 July 2023** on the "parcours d'accueil et d'accompagnement des primo-arrivants et des personnes étrangères," which replaced the earlier 2013/2017 framework, together with its implementing decree of 18 January 2024 and the cooperation agreement of 7 March 2024.

Regarding exemptions: municipalities are responsible for identifying people subject to the obligation and for **determining who is exempt** and handling requests to suspend the obligation.

citations.cited_text:
aux communes bruxelloises, dont la Ville de Bruxelles,

règlementation : détection des personnes primo-arrivantes, détermination des personnes exempté...
citations.title: Question n° 8 de M. Mathias VANDEN BORRE du 2 janvier 2021. ...

content.text: determination of persons exempted from the parcours, management of requests for suspension of the obligation to follow the parcours d'accueil, monitoring of deadlines linked to the parcours, etc.

are municipal competences. Typical exemption/suspension grounds (confirmed by official guidance) generally include situations such as already holding a recognized prior integration certificate from another Belgian region, serious medical incapacity, or specific residence statuses — but the exact list should be verified with your commune or the welcome office, as it is defined by the 2024 implementing decree rather than summarized in general web pages.

## 2) Which authority/office to contact

You must register with one of the **officially recognized "Bureaux d'Accueil" (BAPA)** for French, or **BON** for Dutch. Per the official Brussels.be page:

citations.cited_text:
To follow an integration programme, the newcomer has to turn to one of the welcome offices recognised in Brussels:

**In French:**

- BAPA BXL in Brus...
citations.title: Mandatory integration programme for newcomers in Brussels

content.text: to follow an integration programme, the newcomer has to turn to one of the welcome offices recognised in Brussels: In French: BAPA BXL in Brussels, BAPA Convivial in Forest, BAPA VIA in Molenbeek or Schaerbeek. In Dutch: BON in Brussels, Schaerbeek or Anderlecht

. 

Your municipality (commune/gemeente) will first notify you that you are subject to the obligation when you register in the foreigners' register — this notification triggers your deadlines (see below).

## 3) Registration and completion deadlines

The deadlines are fixed by law and confirmed in recent reporting:
- **Registration deadline**:

citations.cited_text: Les primo-arrivants concernés doivent s'inscrire dans un bureau d'accueil dans les six mois suivant la notification de leur obligation par leur commun...
citations.title: 7 631 primo-arrivants suivent actuellement un parcours d'accueil ...

content.text: primo-arrivants concerned must register with a welcome office within six months following notification of their obligation by their municipality

citations.cited_text: Les primo-arrivants concernés doivent s'inscrire dans un bureau d'accueil dans les six mois suivant la notification de leur obligation par leur commun...
citations.title: 7 631 primo-arrivants suivent actuellement un parcours d'accueil ...

content.text: they then have 18 months to complete their parcours

.

Note that the trigger is the municipality's **notification** of the obligation (not simply your registration date), so make sure your commune has formally notified you, and keep documentation of that date.

In practice, average registration times are faster than the legal maximum:

citations.cited_text: En 2025, le délai moyen entre la notification de l'obligation par la commune et l'inscription auprès d'un bureau d'accueil était de 81 jours pour les ...
citations.title: Plus de 16.000 primo-arrivants ont pris part au parcours d'accueil ...

content.text: in 2025, the average time between notification of the obligation by the commune and registration with a welcome office was 81 days for BAPAs and 71 days for BON

.

## 4) Can you choose French or Dutch?

Yes — you have free choice of language track. This is explicit in the governing 2023 ordonnance:

citations.cited_text: Le principe du libre choix du primo-arrivant, tel qu'il est consacré par l'ordonnance du 20 juillet 2023, demeure toutefois le point de départ.
citations.title: Plus de 16.000 primo-arrivants ont pris part au parcours d'accueil ...

content.text: the principle of free choice for the newcomer, as enshrined in the ordonnance of 20 July 2023, remains nonetheless the starting point

. Concretely, you can choose:
- A **French-language pathway** through BAPA BXL, BAPA Convivial, or BAPA VIA, or
- A **Dutch-language pathway** through BON.

Both tracks cover similar components:

citations.cited_text:
There are two integration programmes in Brussels:

- The **French‑speaking programme**, organised by the Commission Communautaire Française (COCOF)  \...
citations.title: Integration programme in Brussels: what are your obligations? - ...

content.text: a welcoming module, French as a foreign language courses, or Dutch as a foreign language courses, adapted to your level and currently covering levels up to A2
, plus citizenship/orientation training and individualized social support. The French-track content also includes, per earlier official description,

citations.cited_text: Concrètement, le parcours d'accueil inclut un accompagnement dans les démarches socio-administratives, mais aussi des cours de langues, une informatio...
citations.title: Le parcours d'accueil des primo-arrivants devient obligatoire à ...

content.text: accompaniment in socio-administrative procedures, language courses, information on the rights and duties of anyone living in Belgium (a 10-hour module) and citizenship training (50 hours)

.

## 5) Official sources

- **Brussels.be (City of Brussels administrative portal)** — "Mandatory integration programme for newcomers in Brussels" (https://www.brussels.be/mandatory-integration-programme-newcomers-brussels) and its French version "Parcours d'accueil obligatoire à Bruxelles" (https://www.bruxelles.be/parcours-daccueil-obligatoire-bruxelles).
- **Vivalis (Common Community Commission administration responsible for primo-arrivant integration)** — regulatory page listing the legal texts, including the **Ordonnance of 20 July 2023**, the **Arrêté of 18 January 2024**, and the **cooperation agreement of 7 March 2024** (https://www.vivalis.brussels/fr/reglementation/parcours-integration).
- **BON** (Dutch-language welcome office) FAQ (https://www.bon.be/en/you-and-bon/bon-faq).
- **VIA** and other BAPA offices' official sites, confirming mandatory status and operator details.
- Recent press coverage (VRT, 16 October 2026; DH, 19 May 2026) citing official Vivalis/ministerial statistics on registration deadlines and numbers subject to the obligation.

For a precise, case-specific determination of any exemption or suspension that might apply to you, you should contact your commune's population/foreigners' office directly, since they administer exemptions and notify individuals of their specific deadlines.
